translation: After taking the medicine, if the blood still does not stop, food and drink are not taken in, and the qi is deficient with eyes closed and face yellow, the person dies on the eighth day. In all cases of injury to the nasal bridge bone from falls and blows, there is no concern. <ins>Sai Bi Dan (塞鼻丹)</ins> This elixir treats injuries from falls and blows, unceasing bleeding from the nose, dazed spirit and qi, damage to the teeth, deficient floating swelling and pain, and all conditions of nosebleed; all may use it.
